reuse.why: Adds a shared isDailyWeekendSkip predicate and keeps using getNextDate/getDateWithSkippedWeekend, but getUpcomingDates re-does the occurrence lookahead and weekend filtering instead of going through getNextDate-style logic.

duplication.why: The 'over-fetch DAILY_WEEKEND_LOOKAHEAD occurrences and drop weekend dates' mechanism appears twice (getNextDate with find, getUpcomingDates with filter/slice), and schedule-template still layers its own skipWeekend move on top.

placement.why: The rule predicate and lookahead constant live in shared/schedules.ts next to getNextDate; frequency is threaded via the RSchedule data built in rule-utils, consistent with skipWeekend.

scope.why: Edits are confined to the weekend-handling paths and tests.

maintainability.why: The existing noSkipWeekend flag is overloaded (schedule-template passes a computed value that now means 'skip daily weekends' vs 'raw occurrence'), and the skip-vs-move decision is split across three files.

bypasses_abstraction.where: server/schedules/app.ts getUpcomingDates queries RSchedule occurrences and filters weekends itself instead of using the getNextDate weekend handling in shared/schedules.ts.

disguised_duplication.where: getUpcomingDates' take*LOOKAHEAD + filter(!isWeekend) + slice reshapes the take=LOOKAHEAD + find(!isWeekend) logic added to getNextDate.

one_place.where: Which schedules skip is centralised in isDailyWeekendSkip, but the skip itself is applied separately in getNextDate (shared/schedules.ts), getUpcomingDates (server/schedules/app.ts) and via the noSkipWeekend toggle plus its own move in createScheduleList (schedule-template.ts).
